responsibility: Defines a hash-map wrapper with snapshot, commit, and rollback semantics by pairing map mutations with an undo log. This file owns the SnapshotMap and UndoLog types, records inserts/removals/overwrites, exposes snapshot-aware map operations and borrowed views with alternate logs, and applies rollback entries back to the underlying FxHashMap.
same_name_distinction: Within the `mod.rs` group, this file is the transactional map implementation built around undo logs, snapshots, commit, and rollback; unlike the graph modules it manages keyed mutations, and unlike `sso/mod.rs` it contains the mechanics instead of just re-exporting types.
